title: Attributes for selecting a rational dispute resolution method

source.citation: Keršulienė, V., Zavadskas, E. K., Turskis, Z. (2010). Selection of rational dispute resolution method by applying new step-wise weight assessment ratio analysis (SWARA). Journal of Business Economics and Management, 11(2), 243-258.
source.note: Values were read from a text-extracted copy of the published article.

criteria.name: Authority of person solving the dispute

input.criteriaOrder: descending importance, as ranked by the experts

weights.printedIn: Table 1, column q_j, and the text of Section 4

notes: s_j is the average comparative importance given by the experts; the paper prints only the averages, not each expert's answer.
The first criterion has no s_j; k_1 = 1 and w_1 = 1 by definition.
Symbol names follow the paper: w_j is the recalculated weight and q_j the final weight. Many later papers swap the two letters.
